Section 63 of the Act provides as under: (c) The BPC shall prepare the bid documents in accordance with the Guidelines and obtain approval of the Appropriate Government, or alternatively, the BPC can use the Standard Bid Documents notified by the Ministry of Power. Any material deviation from the Standard Bidding Documents shall be made only with the prior approval of the Appropriate Government. Intimation about initiation of the bidding process shall be sent by the BPC to the Appropriate Commission. (k) BPC shall make the final result of evaluation of all bids public.
